verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Unleash supports 'variants' for exposing different versions of a feature, explicitly used for A/B and multivariate testing (unleash-docs-8), which goes beyond simple boolean flags. However, the evidence never explicitly documents variant payload types (string, number, JSON) or dynamic configuration value delivery mechanics, leaving the specifics of the story unconfirmed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of variant payload types (string/number/JSON), SDK examples reading typed variant payloads, and independent corroboration of multivariate config usage in production.
